description: An old sword whose power changes with nearby items.
Strengthens weapons directly adjacent to it.
Lights the way for the belongings of the dead.
Doubles the attack power of weapons diagonally adjacent.
Blocks damage until the next enemy action. Its wide brim takes up space.
A compact extra attack. It has no weapon tag and cannot receive talisman bonuses.
A one-use honey pastry. Once eaten, its space is freed permanently.
A bent weapon. Rotate it to fit gaps and use adjacency bonuses.
A compact defense tool that leaves more room for other items.
A delivery order with a powerful attack that requires careful energy management.
A keepsake that gives a little defense without spending energy.
A mirror found in the bamboo grove, holding someone's last memories.
